Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $1.67 EPS. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.
